minor_findings.summary: The folding sentence leaves its inputs implicit.
minor_findings.evidence: The original explicitly folds the lemon base, meringue, and butter together. The candidate says only to fold gently, although the immediately preceding base and meringue steps plus its butter-at-folding note make the intended three inputs recoverable.

rationale: The candidate preserves every ingredient, all five setup obligations and their timing or temperature, the custard and meringue branches, filled-ramekin preparation, the oven transfer, bake range, and immediate-service output. The fold inputs are not named in one sentence but remain inferable from the surrounding method and uncertainty note, so this does not amount to a materially different recipe.
